keyPoints: Kartesiya tal do lamba akshon se banta hai — kshitij x-aksh, urdhva y-aksh; katav mool bindu O(0,0) hai.
Tal chaar chaturthanshon (quadrants) me batta hai — pehle me (+,+), doosre me (-,+), teesre me (-,-), chauthe me (+,-) — chihn dekh kar chaturthansh pehchano.
Bindu (x, y) me x bhuj (abscissa) aur y koti (ordinate) kehlata hai — pehle x-aksh par chalo, phir y disha me — dhanaatmak y upar, rinatmak neeche.
x-aksh par sthit bindu ki koti 0 hoti hai, jaise (4, 0); y-aksh par bhuj 0, jaise (0, -3).
Bindu aalekhit karke aakaar banao — (0,0), (4,0), (4,3), (0,3) se aayat banta hai — binduon ko kram se jodo.
Akshon se doori: (x, y) ki y-aksh se doori |x| aur x-aksh se doori |y| hoti hai — doori hamesha dhanaatmak hoti hai.
Aam galti: bhuj aur koti ka kram ulta likhna — (3, -2) doosre chaturthansh me nahi, chauthe me hai.
subject: Maths
title: Nirdeshank Jyamiti: Kartesiya Tal
